### Target Application
- **Application Name**: (e.g. Windows Terminal, Helix, Warp, Ghostty, Zed)

### Port Maintenance
- [ ] I am willing to build and maintain this port in `ports/<app-name>/`

### Color Calibration Notes

### Additional Context
Add any other relevant details or links to documentation regarding theme specification for this tool.
